title: Microsoft Edge: Rewrite by Copilot (Writing Assistance) gains enterprise data protection
summary: The briefing's rollout, default state, licensing and administrative controls are supported. One minor correction should acknowledge that Microsoft's privacy page gives a different name for the user-facing switch than the policy reference.

claims.claim: Writing Assistance, also described as Rewrite, edits typed text for tone, format and length within an Edge page.
claims.quote: Writing Assistance with Copilot in Edge, which lets users edit typed text for tone, format, and length within an open page in Microsoft Edge

claims.claim: Microsoft plans enterprise data protection for this feature for users signed in with Microsoft Entra ID.
claims.quote: Once Writing Assistance is available, users signed in with a Microsoft Entra ID will have enterprise data protection when using the feature in Microsoft Edge.

claims.claim: The ComposeInlineEnabled page lists no price.
claims.quote: Searched: Edge Writing Assistance Rewrite Copilot pricing meter limits enterprise data protection. Opened the full ComposeInlineEnabled policy reference; it contains no price.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a separate meter for this Writing Assistance change.
claims.quote: Searched: "Writing Assistance" "meter" "Edge" Copilot; Copilot Chat Edge Rewrite Writing Assistance licensing usage limits pricing. Read ComposeInlineEnabled, Copilot requirements and Copilot overview excerpts; no separate Writing Assistance meter found.

claims.claim: A cap specifically for this Writing Assistance feature is not documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "Rewrite" "Copilot Chat" "limits" "Edge". Read ComposeInlineEnabled and Limits for features in Microsoft Copilot Chat; general fair-use guidance does not identify a Writing Assistance-specific cap.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Why it matters
claims.claim: Text highlighted or entered for Compose is sent to Microsoft after the user clicks Rewrite or Generate.
claims.quote: Text that you've highlighted or inputted for Compose is sent to Microsoft after you click the Rewrite or Generate button, not while you're selecting text.

claims.claim: The cited Learn pages do not describe the feature-specific implementation of enterprise data protection for Writing Assistance.
claims.quote: Searched: Edge Writing Assistance Rewrite Copilot pricing meter limits enterprise data protection. Read ComposeInlineEnabled, Edge privacy Compose and Copilot privacy-and-protections; protection commitments are general, without a Writing Assistance-specific implementation.

claims.claim: The page-content-access documentation describes Purview and Intune MAM blocking settings for Copilot Chat in the Edge sidepane.
claims.quote: This chart covers the behavior of Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Edge for Business which is accessible in the sidepane.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; controls[3].note; Open questions
claims.claim: The documentation does not explicitly identify the same enumerated DLP settings as the Writing Assistance-specific blocking list.
claims.quote: Searched: Edge Writing Assistance DLP copy print download upload policies. Read ComposeInlineEnabled and edge-learnmore-copilot-page-summary-results; the former states DLP blocking generally and the latter explicitly scopes its chart to sidepane chat.

claims.fix: Append: "Microsoft's Edge privacy page instead names the user toggle 'Draft with Microsoft 365 Copilot as you write on the web' under Settings > Languages > Writing assistance (https://learn.microsoft.com/legal/microsoft-edge/privacy#compose); the two pages differ on this label." Keep the policy-reference wording attributed to that reference.

claims.where: Governance controls; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Disabling ComposeInlineEnabled prevents users from using these writing features.
claims.quote: If you disable this policy, users can't use these features.

claims.claim: The Commercial Writing Group Policy setting is documented under Administrative Templates > Microsoft Edge in the Microsoft Edge ADMX.
claims.quote: GP name: Commercial Writing; GP path (Mandatory): Administrative Templates/Microsoft Edge; GP ADMX file name: MSEdge.admx

claims.claim: The policy uses registry path SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge, REG_DWORD ComposeInlineEnabled with 0x00000000 for disabled, and macOS preference key ComposeInlineEnabled.
claims.quote: Path (Mandatory): SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge; Value name: ComposeInlineEnabled; Value type: REG_DWORD; Example registry value: 0x00000000; Preference Key name: ComposeInlineEnabled; Example value: <false/>

claims.claim: No Learn reference documents a policy named InlineComposeEnabled, including its UI or automation surface.
claims.quote: Searched: "InlineComposeEnabled"; "InlineComposeEnabled" Edge policy. Read returned Edge policy index excerpts and ComposeInlineEnabled reference; they document ComposeInlineEnabled, not the differently ordered policy name in MC1146821.

claims.where: controls[0].note; What's changing; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: A documented mapping between the notice's InlineComposeEnabled name and Learn's ComposeInlineEnabled name is unconfirmed.
claims.quote: Searched: "InlineComposeEnabled"; "InlineComposeEnabled" Edge policy. Compared MC1146821 with the full ComposeInlineEnabled reference; neither states that the two spellings are aliases.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: In the Microsoft Edge management service, Copilot > AI-generated text and editing is the setting for eligible text creation and editing.
claims.quote: In the Microsoft Edge management service, select the Copilot tab, then use each dropdown to select Enabled or Disabled; AI-generated text and editing: Provides AI-generated text creation and editing for eligible text fields.

claims.claim: No API or PowerShell operation for the Edge management service's AI-generated text and editing setting is documented in Learn.
claims.quote: Searched: "AI-generated text and editing" "API" Edge management service PowerShell; "Edge management service" "API" configuration policies Copilot. Read Configuring Copilot Features and new-tab configuration excerpts; no corresponding automation operation found.

claims.claim: The Configuring Copilot Features page does not name Rewrite, Writing Assistance, ComposeInlineEnabled or InlineComposeEnabled.
claims.quote: Searched: the full Configuring Copilot Features page for Rewrite, Writing Assistance, ComposeInlineEnabled and InlineComposeEnabled. None appears; it names AI-generated text and editing without linking that setting to either policy name.

claims.claim: Edge management service Copilot feature changes are assigned through a new or existing configuration policy.
claims.quote: use each dropdown to select Enabled or Disabled and assign the changes to either a new or existing configuration policy.

claims.claim: The Purview portal path is Data loss prevention > Settings > Data Loss Prevention > Endpoint DLP settings > Browser and domain restrictions to sensitive data > Sensitive service domain groups.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview portal > Data loss prevention > Settings (gear icon in the upper left hand corner) > Data Loss Prevention > Endpoint DLP settings > Browser and domain restrictions to sensitive data > Sensitive service domain groups.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no automation equivalent for configuring sensitive service domain groups.
claims.quote: Searched: "sensitive service domain groups" PowerShell configure; "sensitive service domain groups" "Set-Dlp"; "sensitive service domain groups" "API". Read Purview configuration and scenario excerpts and the cited creation procedure; no group-configuration call found.

claims.claim: The supplied notice describes manual invocation and no autonomous Writing Assistance action.
claims.quote: Users can choose to use the Writing Assistance feature by manually invoking it through the right-click context menu in Edge.
